patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality photography is used as background for hero sections and as primary content for category and product displays, creating an immersive visual experience.
Product and category listings are presented in flexible grid layouts that adapt to different content types (e.g., 3-column for categories, 5-column for new arrivals, 4-column for stories).
A clean, modern sans-serif typeface is used consistently across all headings and body text, maintaining a minimalist and sophisticated brand identity.
A stark black and white color scheme dominates the UI elements and text, allowing product photography to provide the primary visual interest and color.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay to a solid black background with slightly reduced height and padding as the user scrolls down the page.
The hero image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls, adding depth to the initial view.
Editorial content blocks featuring large imagery and concise text are interspersed throughout the page, breaking up product displays and telling brand stories.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky header that changes its visual properties (background, height, padding) upon scroll, transitioning from a transparent overlay to a solid, more compact bar.
The hero section employs a subtle parallax scrolling effect on its background image, where the image moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth.
Content sections are primarily revealed by static scrolling, with no complex fade-ins or slide-ups observed for individual elements as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, often uppercase labels for categories and buttons.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for buttons, image containers, and input fields, contributing to a modern and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, while product grids maintain a more balanced, organized density.

standout: The site's standout feature is its masterful integration of high-quality, aspirational photography with a minimalist design, making the products and the active lifestyle they represent the absolute focal point. The design feels less like a typical e-commerce site and more like an editorial magazine, using large, full-bleed images to convey emotion and brand identity.
